title.rendered: Board of Directors Work Session & Meeting – June 9, 2021

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Work Session and Regular Meeting on Wednesday, June 9, 2021, at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd). *This will be an in-person public meeting.

  • 5:45 pm – Work Session (District Office Board Room)
  • 7:00 pm – Regular Meeting (District Office Board Room)

The agenda for the meeting can be found here.

Our District is now allowing in-person attendance at all public meetings; public comment will be presented via in-person attendance and sign-up prior to the start of the meeting, up to three minutes in length. Members of the public attending District public meetings may remove face coverings indoors only upon showing written verification of COVID vaccine status, as per OHA guidance; face coverings will be required for all attendees who choose not to provide verification of vaccine status, or will be required of all attendees if students are in attendance.  To view video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3
